title: Subsets
summary: Return every subset of the supplied distinct integers, including the empty subset.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–10 distinct integers in [−10, 10]. A value may be selected at most once.
contractDetails.output-checking: Require every distinct answer once. The outer order and element order within each answer are free.

statement: Return every subset of the supplied distinct integers, including the empty subset. Neither the subset order nor the order of values within a subset matters.

examples.explanation: Each of the two values has two choices.
The empty subset and the singleton are both required.
Three independent choices give eight subsets.

hints: Conceptual: Every value can be included or skipped.
Directional: Build decisions from left to right.
Implementation: At the end of each decision path, save a copy of the chosen values.
complexityAnalysis: O(n·2ⁿ) time to write the results and O(n) auxiliary space for depth-first decisions, excluding output.
